display.purpose: Band and hero titles; heavy Inter statement.

accent.purpose: One Playfair phrase per headline, coral.

title.purpose: Names of real places: stay cards, booking cards, locations.

label.purpose: Numbered editorial labels and field captions; 11px floor.

narrative.overview: HAMLET reads like a calm, well-kept residence. Warm stone paper, thin hairlines, a regular-weight serif for headlines and one deep lagoon-teal accent for every action. Sections are flat and divided by space and lines, never by cards, shadows or gradients. A guest on a phone sees a real place, its all-in price and the way to request it within seconds.
keyCharacteristics: One accent: lagoon teal on warm stone neutrals
Newsreader headlines in one voice, Hanken Grotesk body at 16px
Hairline-ruled lists and flat sections, no nested cards
Motion on hover and press only, plus one gentle scroll reveal
rules: Number sections only when the content is a sequence
No gradients, shadows, stamps, pulsing dots or looping motion
dos: Keep one accent and plain language
Show verification and no-charge-until-accepted at the moment of hesitation
donts: Do not add arrows to buttons
Do not accent a single word in a headline
